name: Spawn Researcher on New Task
description: When the initial general agent completes successfully, spawn a researcher to investigate. The researcher gathers evidence using graph queries and web search, then submits findings. Uses fully-qualified loop predicates so conditions match the triples graph-writer emits on completion.

on_enter.subject: agent.task.research
on_enter.prompt:
Research the following question thoroughly. Use graph_query to check existing knowledge and web_search for external sources.

Question: $entity.triple.agent.loop.result

If the question has clearly separable subtopics, include a SUBTOPICS section at the end of your findings listing each subtopic on its own line prefixed with '- '. Otherwise, provide your complete findings.
